input.summary: Delete the duplicate § 12.4 non-compete binding Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the products or services we may develop, buy or sell, and a term-plus-24-month worldwide non-compete is outside our playbook; we have deleted it, which also removes the conflict with § 12.3's acknowledgement that we have given no non-compete commitment. If you need protection, we could discuss a narrow restriction limited to a single named competing product, during the term only and no longer than 12 months, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.
